title: introduce-cost-seedbank-and-stepped-quant-regulator
author: Aisha Verma
description:
Motivation: Provide an operator-friendly, declarative bank of cost-presets (seedbank) and a conservative stepped quantization regulator that can be applied per-tenant or per-model to reduce unit token cost without surprising regressions. This PR introduces a declarative 'cost seed' manifest format, a small engine that compiles seeds into runtime hints (batching/caching defaults, quant profiles), and a control-plane guard (stepped-quant-regulator) that enforces staged rollouts with telemetry-driven rollback heuristics.

What this changes: Adds: 1) cost-seed schema + CLI importer (tools/cost-seed/) 2) a runtime hints compiler (pkg/econ/seedcompiler) that converts seeds to tenant-scoped defaults 3) stepped quant regulator service (services/quant-regulator/) that orchestrates gradual quant rollouts with safety checks 4) telemetry hooks and new eval events (observability/metrics:econ.seed.apply, econ.quant.rollback) 5) integration tests & a lightweight simulator used in CI (tests/econ-sim) 6) docs and example seed manifests (docs/cost-seeds.md, examples/seedbank/).

Why unique: Unlike previous autotuners, this PR emphasizes a human-auditable seedbank (presets-as-code), explicit staged quant steps, and a compact simulator to validate economic and quality impact before applying to production. The regulator uses conservative thresholds (95th percentile latency and a quality delta guard tied to eval prompt sets) to avoid silent regressions.

Checklist: - [x] Add cost-seed schema + importer CLI - [x] Implement seed compiler and tenant propagation - [x] Implement stepped quant regulator API + orchestration - [x] Wire telemetry and tracing spans - [x] Add unit and integration tests (simulator-backed) - [x] Add docs and example manifests - [x] Run perf benchmarks on small and medium models - [x] Security review for KMS usage in quant artifacts

High-level rollout plan: land on canary cluster, import curated seedbank for a single internal tenant, run 48h sim-backed smoke, enable regulator with dry-run, then flip enforcement if telemetry stays green.

Notes: The description and code intentionally keep seed semantics minimal: seeds map to a small set of hints (preferred batch size, prefill window, cache TTL, quant profile id). The regulator persists decisions to the tenant ledger and emits structured audit events for ex post review.

release_notes: Introduce 'cost seedbank' (presets-as-code) and a conservative stepped quant regulator. Operators can author seeds to provide tenant-scoped batching, caching, and quantization defaults. The regulator provides staged rollouts and automatic rollback on quality/latency regressions. Includes CLI importer, simulator, telemetry, and docs.
